cues.en: Now to the weather forecast for the inshore waters of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, valid for the following twenty four hours.
cues.zh: 现在为您播报大不列颠及北爱尔兰近海海域天气预报，未来 24 小时内有效。

cues.en: The general situation: showers or longer spells of thundery rain will continue to affect the Far South East Of England through tonight and Thursday morning. Elsewhere, though, a ridge of high pressure will bring settled conditions
cues.zh: 总体天气情况：今晚至周四上午，英格兰极东南部地区将持续受到阵雨或较长时间雷雨天气的影响；不过其他地区受高压脊控制，天气较为平稳，

cues.en: until a strengthening south westerly airflow spreads rain eastwards across the country during Thursday night and Friday.
cues.zh: 直到周四夜间至周五，一股逐渐增强的西南气流会将降雨自西向东推向全国。

cues.en: Cape Wrath to Rattray Head including Orkney.
cues.zh: 从愤怒角到拉特里角，包含奥克尼群岛。

cues.en: West four or five backing South West five or six, occasionally seven later, perhaps scale eight later near Cape Wrath.
cues.zh: 西风4到5级，转西南风5到6级，稍后局地7级，愤怒角附近稍后可能达8级。

cues.en: Drizzle at times in North. Good occasionally moderate in North.
cues.zh: 北部偶有毛毛雨。北部能见度好，偶有中等。

cues.en: Routary head to Berwick Upon Tweed. Variable three or four becoming South West four or five, occasionally six later.
cues.zh: 拉特里角到特威德河畔伯威克。风向不定3到4级，转西南风4到5级，稍后局地6级。
特威德河畔伯威克到惠特比。

cues.en: Northwest backing south or south... Southeast,
cues.zh: 西北风逆转为南风或南……东南风，

cues.en: then veering southwest later, three or four, occasionally five later.
cues.zh: 随后顺转为西南风，3到4级，稍后局地5级。

cues.en: Whitby, two dribble to point. Northerly four or five, occasionally six at first in far south, becoming variable three or four, then becoming south westerly later. Fair, good.
cues.zh: 惠特比至德里角：东北风，风力2级；北风4到5级，南部远海初期偶尔达6级，之后转为风向多变、风力3到4级，晚些时候转西南风。海况还算晴好。不错。
吉布拉法角至北法伦角。

cues.en: Northerly five or six, veering northeasterly four or five, then becoming variable three or four later.
cues.zh: 北风5到6级，转东北风4到5级，晚些时候转为风向多变、风力3到4级。

cues.en: Showers, occasionally thundery, becoming fair later.
cues.zh: 有阵雨，偶尔伴有雷暴，晚些时候转晴。
海况良好，初期偶尔较差。

cues.en: cyclonic at first in east, otherwise northerly or northeasterly four or five, occasionally six at first, becoming variable three later.
cues.zh: 东部起初有气旋性天气，其余地区吹北风或东北风，风力四到五级，起初局部六级，之后转为多变风，风力三级。
局部伴有雷暴，之后转晴。
能见度良好，起初局部较差。

cues.en: Celci bill to Lime Regis, northerly four or five, occasionally six at first and east, becoming variable three or four later. Showers at first and east, otherwise fair.
cues.zh: 从 Celci bill 到 Lime Regis，吹北风，风力四到五级，起初局部六级，东部也是如此，之后转为多变风，风力三到四级。起初有阵雨，东部也是如此，其余地区天气晴好。

cues.en: Lime Regis to Land's End including the Isles Of Scilly.
cues.zh: 莱姆里吉斯到兰兹角，包含锡利群岛。

cues.en: North four or five becoming variable mainly northwest three or four. Fair,
cues.zh: 北风4或5级，后转为不定风向，主要是西北风3或4级。晴朗，

cues.en: Land's End to St David's Head, including the Bristol Channel.
cues.zh: 兰兹角到圣大卫角，包含布里斯托尔海峡。

cues.en: North, backing west, four or five, decreasing three at times, fair, good.
cues.zh: 北风，后逆转为西风，4或5级，有时减弱到3级，晴朗，能见度良好。

cues.en: St David's Head to Great Orm Head, including St George's Channel. Northerly, four or five, backing westerly, two or three then south westerly, three or four later occasionally,
cues.zh: 圣大卫角到大奥姆角，包含圣乔治海峡。北风，4或5级，逆转为偏西风，2或3级，晚些时候转西南风3或4级，偶有，

cues.en: five later in north. Fair? Good.
cues.zh: 晚些时候北部达5级。晴朗？能见度良好。

cues.en: Great Ormhead to the Mall Of Galloway
North westerly backing south westerly four or five, occasionally three at first, increasing six at times later in north.
cues.zh: 西北风转西南风4或5级，初时偶有3级，后北部风力偶增至6级。

cues.en: Isle Of Man. Northwest five or six, decreasing three or four, then backing Southwest four or five later.
cues.zh: 马恩岛。西北风5或6级，减弱至3或4级，稍后转西南风4或5级。
福伊尔湖至卡灵福德湖。

cues.en: four or five, becoming variable three, then becoming southwest,
cues.zh: 4或5级，转多变风向3级，随后转西南风，

cues.en: four or five later, occasionally six later.
Mile Of Galloway to Mile Of Kintyre, including the Firth Of Clyde and North Channel.
cues.zh: 加洛韦角（Mull of Galloway）至金泰尔角（Mull of Kintyre），包含克莱德湾（Firth of Clyde）和北海峡（North Channel）。

cues.en: Northwesterly four or five becoming variable three, then becoming southerly or southwesterly four or five later.
cues.zh: 西北风 4 到 5 级转不定向风 3 级，稍后转南风或西南风 4 到 5 级。
稍后局部 6 级。晴朗。能见度良好。

cues.en: Mile Of Contiar to Ardnemurchen Point. North westerly three or four, backing south westerly four or five, increasing six or seven later in north. Mainly fair. Good.
cues.zh: 金泰尔角（Mull of Kintyre）至阿德纳默亨角（Ardnamurchan Point）。西北风 3 到 4 级，逆时针转西南风 4 到 5 级，稍后北部风力增强至 6 到 7 级。大部晴朗。能见度良好。

cues.en: points to Cape Wrath, west four or five, backing southwest five to seven, perhaps gale eight later, occasional drizzle, then rain later, moderate or good, occasionally poor later.
cues.zh: Cape Wrath 海域：西风四到五级，转西南偏西风五到七级，稍后可能达到八级大风；偶有小雨，之后有雨。能见度中等或良好，稍后偶尔较差。

cues.en: Shetland Isles, west or southwest, four or five,
cues.zh: 设得兰群岛：西风或西南风，四到五级，

cues.en: increasing six or seven later, occasional drizzle, good, occasionally moderate.
cues.zh: 稍后增强到六到七级；偶有小雨，能见度良好，偶尔中等。

cues.en: And that completes the shipping bulletin.
cues.zh: 航运天气预报到此结束。

cues.en: Thank you for your company this evening. This is Tom Sanders in Broadcasting House in London.
cues.zh: 感谢各位今晚的陪伴。我是汤姆·桑德斯，在伦敦广播大楼为您播报。

cues.en: Wishing you a safe and peaceful night.
cues.zh: 祝你度过一个平安宁静的夜晚。

cues.en: Good night. This is BBC Radio four. Now the shipping forecast issued by the Met Office on behalf of the Maritime and Coast Guard Agency at fifteen on Friday, August 11.
cues.zh: 晚安。这里是 BBC Radio Four。现在播报气象局代表海事与海岸警卫署发布的航运预报，时间是 8 月 11 日星期五 15 时。

cues.en: There are warnings of gales in Viking, North at Cirra, Rockall, Malin, Hebrides,
cues.zh: 维京、北部的希拉、罗卡尔、马林、赫布里底群岛有烈风警报，

cues.en: Bailly, Fair Isle, Faroes, and South East Iceland.
cues.zh: 贝利、费尔岛、法罗群岛和冰岛东南部也有烈风警报。
贝利以西 100 海里有低压，中心气压 995 百帕，

cues.en: expected Norwegian c nine ninety eight by 1,800
cues.zh: 预计星期五 18 时移至挪威海，中心气压 998 百帕。
菲茨罗伊以西偏北，高空 1,032，

cues.en: The area forecasts for the next twenty four hours, Viking, north at Cirra. Southerly, five to seven. Occasionally, gale eight for a time in North.
cues.zh: 未来二十四小时海区预报：维京、北部海区。偏南风，五至七级。北部海区一度偶有八级大风。

cues.en: Fair, then rain. Good, becoming moderate or poor.
cues.zh: 晴，随后有雨。能见度良好，之后转为一般或较差。

cues.en: South at Cirra, westerly four or five, backing south westerly five or six. Rain later, good, occasionally poor later.
cues.zh: 南部海区，偏西风四至五级，转为西南风五至六级。稍后有雨，能见度良好，之后偶尔较差。
福斯湾、克罗马蒂湾，第四海区。

cues.en: Southwest, five to seven. Fair, then occasionally,
cues.zh: 西南风5到7级。晴，随后偶有，
能见度良好，稍后偶有转差。

cues.en: South, four or five, veering Southwest, five or six. Rain later. Good occasionally poor later.
cues.zh: 南风4到5级，顺时针转西南风5到6级。稍后有雨。能见度良好，稍后偶有转差。

cues.en: Northwest backing Southwest four or five. Mainly fair. Good.
cues.zh: 西北风逆时针转西南风4到5级。大部晴。能见度良好。

cues.en: Variable three or four becoming Southwesterly four or five. Showers later, good.
cues.zh: 风向不定3到4级，转西南风4到5级。稍后有阵雨，能见度良好。

cues.en: Thames, Dover, white. Variable three or four becoming west or Southwest four or five. Occasionally six later. Showers at first, mainly good.
cues.zh: 泰晤士、多佛、怀特。风向不定3到4级，转西或西南风4到5级。稍后偶有6级。初时有阵雨，能见度大部良好。

cues.en: North Westerly, four zero five, backing South Westerly, five zero six. Drizzle later, good, becoming moderate or poor later.
cues.zh: 西北偏北风，风力4级，转西南偏南风，风力5至6级。稍后有毛毛雨，天气良好，之后转为中等或较差。

cues.en: variable three or four, fair, good.
cues.zh: 风向多变，风力3至4级，天气晴朗，海况良好。

cues.en: five to seven. Perhaps scale eight later in south.
cues.zh: 风力5至7级。南部稍后可能达到8级。

cues.en: North westerly, four or five at first and east. Otherwise, westerly or south westerly, five or six.
cues.zh: 起初和东部吹西北风，风力4至5级。其他地区吹西风或西南风，风力5至6级。

cues.en: Fair, then drizzle. Good, becoming moderate or poor.
cues.zh: 晴，后有毛毛雨。能见度良好，转中等或差。

cues.en: fast net, Irish Sea. West or southwest, five or six. Fair, then rain or drizzle, good, becoming moderate or poor.
cues.zh: 法斯特耐特（Fastnet），爱尔兰海。西到西南风，5到6级。晴，后有雨或毛毛雨，能见度良好，转中等或差。

cues.en: Southwest, five to seven, veering Northwest, four or five later, occasional rain, good, occasionally poor.
cues.zh: 西南风5到7级，后顺转西北风4到5级，偶有降雨，能见度良好，偶有差。

cues.en: Southwest veering Northwest later, five to seven, occasionally gale eight at first,
cues.zh: 西南风，后顺转西北风，5到7级，初时偶有8级大风，

cues.en: rain then showers, moderate or poor, becoming good.
cues.zh: 有雨后转阵雨，能见度中等或差，转良好。

cues.en: Bailey, cyclonic six to gale eight becoming north five to seven, rain then showers, moderate or poor, becoming good.
cues.zh: 贝利海区：气旋风6级增强至大风8级，后转北风5至7级；先有雨后转阵雨；能见度中等或较差，后转好。

cues.en: Fair Isle, Southwest becoming cyclonic later, six to gale eight.
cues.zh: 费尔岛海区：西南风，稍后转气旋风，6级增强至大风8级。

cues.en: Rain, showers later, moderate or poor, becoming good later.
cues.zh: 有雨，稍后转阵雨；能见度中等或较差，稍后转好。

cues.en: cyclonic becoming northerly five to seven, occasionally gale eight. Rain, showers later, moderate or poor, becoming good later.
cues.zh: 气旋风转北风5至7级，阵风8级大风。有雨，稍后转阵雨；能见度中等或较差，稍后转好。

cues.en: Now to the weather reports from coastal stations for 2,300.
cues.zh: 现在播报23点沿海气象站的天气报告。

cues.en: Southwest by South six, slight rain, four miles, ten fifteen falling.
cues.zh: 西南偏南六级，微雨，能见度四英里，气压1015百帕，下降。
小毛毛雨，能见度两英里，气压1009百帕，

cues.en: South by West four, nine miles,
cues.zh: 西偏南四级，能见度九英里，
西南偏南二级，能见度22英里，

cues.en: Southwest one, ten twenty one rising slowly.
cues.zh: 西南风一级，气压1021，缓慢上升。

cues.en: North North East three eleven miles,
cues.zh: 东北偏北风三级，距离11海里，

cues.en: ten twenty two rising more slowly.
Northwest three, 22 miles, ten twenty four now falling.
cues.zh: 西北风三级，距离22海里，气压1024，现在正在下降。

cues.en: 11 miles, ten twenty four, rising slowly.
cues.zh: 距离11海里，气压1024，缓慢上升。
西北偏西风3级，能见度27英里，气压1026百帕，

cues.en: South by West five, seven miles, 1,022,
cues.zh: 南偏西风5级，能见度7英里，气压1022百帕，
西偏南风3级，能见度27英里，气压1022百帕，

cues.en: Ronalds Way, Southwest by south four, 16 miles, 1,021
cues.zh: 罗纳兹威，西南偏南风4级，能见度16英里，气压1021百帕，

cues.en: Mallin Head, south by west six,

cues.zh: 能见度16英里，气压1016百帕，正在下降。
麦克拉哈尼什自动气象站，
东南偏南二级，能见度16英里，

cues.en: Now for the weather forecast for the inshore waters of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, valid for the following twenty four hours.
cues.zh: 现在播报大不列颠及北爱尔兰近海海域未来24小时天气预报。

cues.en: a ridge of high pressure across southern areas will collapse southwards
cues.zh: 南部地区上空的高压脊将向南减弱消散，

cues.en: as a deep area of low pressure moving north eastwards between Iceland and Scotland sweeps its weather fronts south eastwards.
cues.zh: 一股深厚低压正向东北移动，经过冰岛与苏格兰之间，并将其锋面带向东南扫过。

cues.en: A new ridge of high pressure will edge slowly eastwards on Saturday.
cues.zh: 周六，一道新的高压脊将缓慢向东移动。

cues.en: Cape Wrath to Rattery Head, including Orkney.
cues.zh: 从恐惧角到拉特里角，包括奥克尼群岛。

cues.en: South westerly veering north westerly later five to seven Occasionally gale eight in north
cues.zh: 西南风，稍后转西北风，风力五到七级；北部偶尔达到八级大风。

cues.en: Occasional rain or drizzle Moderate or good Occasionally poor in North
cues.zh: 偶有降雨或毛毛雨。能见度中等或良好，北部偶尔较差。

cues.en: Rattray Head to Berwick Upon Tweed
cues.zh: 从拉特雷角到特威德河畔贝里克。

cues.en: Southwest veering west later five to seven. Fair, then occasional rain. Good, occasionally moderate.
cues.zh: 西南风，稍后转西风，风力五到七级。先晴好，之后偶有降雨。能见度良好，偶尔中等。

cues.en: Berwick Upon Tweed to Whitby. South westerly veering westerly later four or five. Occasionally six in north. Fair, then occasional rain. Mainly good.
cues.zh: 贝里克厄蓬特威德至惠特比。西南风转西风，稍后风力4到5级，北部偶尔6级。天气晴好，间或有雨。大部分时间天气良好。

cues.en: South West three or four, occasionally five later.
cues.zh: 西南风3到4级，稍后偶尔5级。
稍后间或有雨。大部分时间天气良好。
吉伯勒尔角至诺斯福兰。

cues.en: Variable becoming south westerly three or four, increasing five,
cues.zh: 风向多变，转西南风，风力3到4级，增强至5级，

cues.en: occasionally six later, occasional rain later, mainly good.
cues.zh: 稍后偶尔6级。稍后间或有雨，大部分时间天气良好。

cues.en: backing westerly or south westerly three or four, increasing five or six later, occasional rain later, mainly good.
cues.zh: 风向转为西风或西南风，风力 3 至 4 级，之后增强至 5 至 6 级；晚些时候偶有降雨，整体能见度良好。

cues.en: Northwest three or four, backing West or Southwest five or six, occasional rain later, good, occasionally poor later.
cues.zh: 西北风，风力 3 至 4 级，转为西风或西南风，风力 5 至 6 级；晚些时候偶有降雨，能见度良好，之后偶尔较差。

cues.en: Lime Regis to Land's End including the Isles Of Scilly.
cues.zh: Lime Regis 至 Land's End，包括锡利群岛。

cues.en: Northwest four or five, backing west or Southwest five or six. Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle.
cues.zh: 西北风，风力 4 至 5 级，转为西风或西南风，风力 5 至 6 级。天气晴好，之后偶有降雨或毛毛雨。
良好，随后转为中等或较差。

cues.en: Land's End to St David's Head including the Bristol Channel.
cues.zh: 兰兹角至圣戴维斯角，包括布里斯托尔海峡。

cues.en: West four or five backing South West five or six for a time. Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle.
cues.zh: 西风四到五级，随后转为西南风五到六级，持续一段时间。天气晴好，随后偶有降雨或毛毛雨。
良好，随后转为中等或较差。

cues.en: St David's Head to Great Orm Head including St George's Channel,
cues.zh: 圣戴维斯角至大奥姆角，包括圣乔治海峡，

cues.en: South West veering west later five or six.
cues.zh: 西南风转为西风，稍后五到六级。

cues.en: Fair then occasional rain or drizzle,
cues.zh: 天气晴好，随后偶有降雨或毛毛雨，
良好，随后转为中等或较差。

cues.en: Great warm heads to the Mile of Galloway.
cues.zh: 大沃姆角至加洛韦海角。

cues.en: Southwest, five or six, veering west, four or five later.
cues.zh: 西南风，五到六级，风向转偏西，稍后四到五级。

cues.en: Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle. Good, becoming moderate,
cues.zh: 能见度良好，随后间有降雨或毛毛雨。风力良好，转为中等，

cues.en: West or southwest three or four. Showers. Good.

cues.en: west or southwest five to seven becoming variable three or four later,

cues.en: or north easterly: four or five, becoming variable: three or four. Showers at first: good.

cues.en: Here now is the weather forecast for the inshore waters of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, valid for the following twenty four hours, issued by the Met Office at two thousand three hundred on Tuesday, August 29.
cues.zh: 现在播报英国和北爱尔兰近海海域天气预报，有效期为未来24小时。预报由气象局于8月29日星期二23时发布。

cues.en: on Wednesday, a generally slack pressure pattern affects the British Isles between a slight ridge of high pressure across South West England and a trough across Scotland.
cues.zh: 星期三，英国群岛受较弱的气压场影响，西南英格兰上空有弱高压脊，苏格兰上空有低压槽。

cues.en: However, winds will strengthen for a time across the South East Of England as a thundery low across the near continent moves steadily north eastwards.
cues.zh: 不过，随着欧洲大陆附近的雷暴低压稳定向东北方向移动，英格兰东南部的风力将一度增强。

cues.en: A predominantly slack flow will affect all parts on Thursday as pressure slowly builds from the South West.
cues.zh: 周四，随着气压自西南方向缓慢回升，各地将主要受微弱气流影响。

cues.en: Cape Wrath to Rattray Head including Orkney.
cues.zh: 拉特里角至怒角，包括奥克尼群岛。

cues.en: South West four or five, occasionally six at first, becoming variable three or four later.
cues.zh: 西南风4到5级，初时偶有6级，随后转为不定向风3到4级。

cues.en: Rattray Head to Berwick Upon Tweed.
cues.zh: Rattray Head 至 Berwick Upon Tweed。

cues.zh: 西南风四至五级，之后转为西风三级至四级。

cues.en: Fair at first, then rain or showers.
cues.zh: 起初天气晴好，之后有雨或阵雨。

cues.zh: 北风3至4级，克罗默与北前滩之间增强至5至6级。

cues.en: Then backing north westerly four or five later.
cues.zh: 稍后逆转为西北风4至5级。

cues.en: Thundery showers at first in south, then rain at times.
cues.zh: 南部初有雷阵雨，随后间歇性有雨。

cues.en: Moderate or good, occasionally poor at first.
cues.zh: 中等或良好，初时偶有差。

cues.en: three or four increasing five or six, then backing westerly or north westerly four or five later.

cues.en: Thundery showers at first then rain at times.

cues.en: Moderate or good occasionally poor at first.
cues.zh: 能见度中等或良好，起初偶尔较差。

偶有降雨，之后天气转好。

cues.en: Rain at times, showers later. Good, occasionally moderate at first.
cues.zh: 有时下雨，之后有阵雨。能见度良好，起初偶尔中等。

能见度良好，初时偶见一般。

cues.en: West or northwest three or four, occasionally five later.
cues.zh: 西风或西北风3到4级，稍后有时5级。

cues.en: good. And that completes the shipping bulletin, so until the next time this is Jim Lee wishing you a safe and peaceful night. Good night.
cues.zh: 能见度好。航运天气预报播送完毕，我是 Jim Lee，祝大家度过一个平安宁静的夜晚，下次再会。晚安。
